#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll modPow(ll a, ll e, ll mod) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &m, &k);
    const ll mod = 998244353;
    int lim = min(n, k);
    vector<vector<ll>> dp(k + 1, vector<ll>(lim + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= lim; ++j) {
            dp[i][j] = (dp[i-1][j] * j % mod + dp[i-1][j-1] * (n - j + 1) % mod) % mod;
        }
    }
    ll invm = modPow(m, mod - 2, mod);
    ll res = 0;
    vector<ll> pow(lim + 1);
    pow[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= lim; ++i) {
        pow[i] = pow[i-1] * invm % mod;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= lim; ++i) {
        res = (res + dp[k][i] * pow[i] % mod) % mod;
    }
    printf("%lld\n", res);
    return 0;
}
